definitions.explanation: Help or assistance offered to someone in trouble or distress. Often used figuratively to describe timely aid that saves a dire situation.

examples.japanese: {救|すく}いの{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{伸|の}べる→差し伸べる：07265_sashinoberu⟧。
⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{救|すく}いの{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: A helping hand appeared when I was in trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災者|ひさいしゃ}→被災者：25337_hisaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{救|すく}いの{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{伸|の}べる→差し伸べる：07265_sashinoberu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Many volunteers gathered to lend a helping hand to the disaster victims.

notes:
{救|すく}いの{手|て} literally means "hand of rescue" and refers to timely help given to someone in trouble. It is often used figuratively and carries a somewhat dramatic or literary tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {救|すく}いの{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}し{伸|の}べる→差し伸べる：07265_sashinoberu⟧: to extend a helping hand (the most common collocation)
- {救|すく}いの{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to seek a helping hand
- {救|すく}いの{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: a helping hand appears

USAGE:
Frequently appears in news reports about disaster relief, charitable aid, and personal crises. Also used in everyday speech to describe someone who helped at a critical moment.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{手|て}を{貸|か}す→手を貸す：22775_tewokasu⟧: to lend a hand (more casual)
- {助|たす}け{舟|ぶね}: a lifeboat, timely help (similar figurative use)
- ⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧: aid, assistance (more formal/official)
